summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group, Inc., a Japanese bank holding company, furnishing its audited consolidated Japanese GAAP financial statements for the years ended March 31, 2026 and 2025, as part of its annual securities report to Japanese authorities. The filing consists only of standard financial statements and an independent auditor's report. There is no transaction, change in control, delisting, restructuring, or any special situation event. This is a routine periodic report for a foreign private issuer and does not constitute a special situation under any of the predefined categories.
